title: Performance Requirements and Methods of Tests of TV Ferrite Components, Part 2: U Core for Line Driver Transformers
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This Standard ( Part 2 ) covers performance requirements and methods of tests of U core for line driver transformers.
clause_3_terminology: Performance Requirements and Methods of Tests of TV Ferrite Components
Part 2: U Core for Line Driver Transformers

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
